definitions.explanation: A day considered favorable for undertaking important activities such as weddings, moving house, opening a business, or other significant events. Based on traditional calendar systems and superstitions.

examples.japanese: {大安|たいあん}は{吉日|きちじつ}とされる。
examples.english: Taian is considered an auspicious day.

examples.japanese: {結婚式|けっこんしき}は{吉日|きちじつ}に{行|おこな}いたい。
examples.english: I want to hold the wedding on an auspicious day.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しの{日取|ひど}りは{吉日|きちじつ}を{選|えら}んで{決|き}めた。
examples.english: We chose an auspicious day for the moving date.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{大安|たいあん}{吉日|きちじつ} (most auspicious day on the six-day calendar)
・{吉日|きちじつ}を{選|えら}ぶ (choose a lucky day)
・{吉日|きちじつ}に{行|おこな}う (carry out on an auspicious day)

Also read as きちにち. The traditional {六曜|ろくよう} (six-day) calendar cycle determines which days are considered lucky or unlucky. {大安|たいあん} is the most auspicious day, while {仏滅|ぶつめつ} is the most inauspicious. Many Japanese still consult the calendar for weddings and other ceremonies.
